status: post-review diagnostic plan written before new probes
scope: Local artifact analysis and bounded deterministic witnesses, not another recipient study
steps: Inventory/hash all used source, records, prompts and prepared inputs before importing any copied module; repeat after all analyses.
Create an A/B/C field-vocabulary-predicate-unscored-content table, explicitly separating original A from its later analysis correction and B's historical scorer from corrected admission variants.

Extract the 96 already executed C reference/always_restore/always_hold rows; do not rerun these policies. Preserve case/state/arm/interface, actions, retrievals, checks, outcomes, and reference-render-only byte labels.

On copies of each of the four valid U contexts, test baseline, authorization-only revocation, and protected-note-only change. Keep executable manifests, current bindings and historical evidence identical. Compare frozen technical reconciliation/gate fields with the frozen composite oracle predicate; do not replace the scorer.
Map each delivery obligation to actual frozen G/P prompts, context documents and action responses. Verify G is exactly the P prefix and that only the derived technical projection is appended.

Execute at most 32 new deterministic information-grounded witness paths (4 cases x 2 states x G/P x 2 interfaces), no checks or CLI. Decisions may inspect only initial exposed prompt and returned tool data, not case/state labels, fixture internals or oracle. Initial P support may replace history/dependency acquisition ONLY under an explicit trusted-current-projection assumption; authorization and protected-file consistency must still be read. Otherwise acquire all four documents and establish reuse from visible binding and restoration data.

Use one paired dependency-only counterfactual to test the proposed information boundary: equal G prompt, workspace and authorization/protection data but changed current dependency binding. This is a post-hoc instrument witness, not a recipient error. If the claimed selective path is not supported by the exposed data, report it as unestablished.

Apply explicitly generic final-report-only, committed-effect-only and full-event views to all 160 preserved C records and, separately, three retained B control pairs. Never call these competitor implementations or mix their counts with recipients.
Write JSON/CSV/logs and a full English report with exact source paths/hashes, observed limitations and failures. No new framework, tuning, statistical inference, novelty claim or publication action.

generic_views.final_only: Presence and structured final technical/disposition fields only; free-text explanation excluded; no access to earlier proposals/commits or current workspace.
generic_views.commit_only: Sequence of actual committed snapshot eligibility at commit time, without proposals or terminal report. A later workspace edit does not retroactively invalidate a correct committed snapshot.
generic_views.full_event: Verified request eligibility, commit eligibility/identity, terminal structured report, current-state eligibility where retained, and observability/completeness flags. Generic observation vector, not a new historical scorer.

interpretive_constraints: The three measurement views are projections of retained observations, not implementations of named prior evaluations.
Expected outcomes are authored in expectations.json from the declared contracts before probes, not generated by the gate/oracle being tested.
A successful always-restore policy demonstrates fixed-generator feasibility, not an information-grounded optimum.

A conditional P selective witness is not unique optimality, actual recipient behavior, cognitive efficiency or transfer. If trusting the initial projection is disallowed, the witness must not claim omission justified.
Gate feedback and restoration descriptions are trusted tool-contract observations. The P projection alone does not certify authorization or protected-file preservation.
Original outcomes and source remain untouched. Source/receipt integrity is not independent authorship, malicious-host authentication or empirical prevalence.
execution: python3 -I -B; sys.dont_write_bytecode=True; copied own instrument sources in runtime/, input data in inputs/, authored scripts in scripts/; no upstream Python package execution
expected_runtime: minutes on local CPU; no training or hosted inference
